# bragg heads to G2E Las Vegas and SBC Summit Lisbon


September 7, 2026


bragg is bringing it to both sides of the Atlantic. This September, we’re splitting our team across two of the biggest events in igaming, attending


[G2E Las Vegas](https://www.globalgamingexpo.com/) and


[SBC Summit Lisbon](https://sbcevents.com/sbc-summit/) simultaneously.


### **Two shows, one week**


Our teams will be on the ground in both Las Vegas and Lisbon, ready to connect with operators, partners, and the wider industry.


**G2E** **** 📍 The Venetian Expo, Las Vegas


📅 28 September – 1 October 2026


**SBC Summit** **** 📍 Feira Internacional de Lisboa, MEO Arena


📅 29 September – 1 October 2026


### **What we’re bringing to the table**


Whether you’re in Vegas or Lisbon, our teams are ready to show you our captivating games, smart gamification, and a platform engineered to grow any operator, anywhere.


### **Let’s meet**


Book a meeting with our team at[\[email protected\]](https://bragg.group/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#e390828f8690a38191828484cd84918c9693) .


See you there!
